headline: JSW Energy Limited: NCLT-ordered Shareholders and Creditors Meetings Concluded
sum: JSW Energy has completed NCLT-ordered meetings of equity shareholders and unsecured creditors pursuant to a 2 June 2026 National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench order, with outcomes filed to NSE.
detail: JSW Energy Limited informed NSE of the outcome and proceedings of equity shareholders and unsecured creditors meetings convened under NCLT Mumbai Bench Order dated 2 June 2026. The dual-meeting structure—separating equity from unsecured creditors—is typical of IBC Chapter XI (corporate debt restructuring) or Part II (insolvency) proceedings where statutory approval thresholds differ by class. The 20 July 2026 disclosure to the Exchange constitutes formal notice of meeting outcomes; the next gate is NCLT approval of the scheme or resolution plan.
